about_the_game:
Toy Smash Kaboom! is an indie game blending spatial organization, physics-based collisions, and auto-battler elements. Step into a wildly imaginative toy world where you manage your inventory, craft items, and set traps to build your own Kaboom Legion! From ground clashes to aerial strikes and spell bombardments, combine quirky gear in countless ways to forge tactical builds and dominate the battlefield!

               

Summon units for intense "collision" battles where victory isn’t just about numbers! Charge boldly to knock opponents off the table, flipping the battlefield in unpredictable ways and making every tabletop clash wildly exciting.

In Toy Smash Kaboom!, every toy has unique mechanics and can trigger synergies through crafting and pairing, enabling endlessly varied tactical combinations.

Placement & Crafting

Victory isn’t just about choosing toys—it’s about mastering the art of placement on your desk! Every grid is a tactical choice. Plan wisely, combine cleverly, and even craft rare, powerful units to unleash your build’s full potential on the tabletop!          

Build Your Playstyle

With over 200 strategic toys, craft your unique tactical system!

  • 60+ summonable toys clash head-on in tabletop battles

  • 15+ trap toys to turn the tide of battle

  • 150+ magic toys to enhance your core strategy and chain devastating effects    

From physics-based collisions and trap placement to creative storytelling, we’ve infused traditional auto-battlers with imagination and interactivity, delivering a fresh strategic experience packed with childhood wonder.

Collisions & Knockouts

Summon units for “collision” battles where victory isn’t just about stats—charging courageously to knock opponents off the desk can shift the tide, making every tabletop clash unpredictable.

Trap Placement

Use desk space to set cunning traps, disrupt enemy attacks, and create opportunities for counterstrikes.

   

Face off against players worldwide, pitting your builds against theirs. Refine your strategies in mirror matches, optimize your combos, and climb the ranks to claim victory!

Choose Your Hero

Each hero comes with a unique toy collection and battle mechanics, shaping your build direction and tactical approach.

  • Doll Chef: Kitchen defense commander, excelling at control and fortification—a reliable anchor for defensive playstyles.

  • Hamster Doctor: Leader of the hamster horde, summoning swarms of small units to overwhelm foes with sheer numbers.

  • Puppet Musician: Rhythm maestro, manipulating melodies to speed up allies and disrupt enemies, controlling the battlefield’s tempo.
